gloss: duty of confidentiality; obligation of secrecy

definitions.gloss: duty of confidentiality; obligation of secrecy
definitions.explanation: A legal or professional obligation to keep certain information secret. Applies to lawyers, doctors, public officials, and others who handle sensitive information.

examples.japanese: {守秘義務|しゅひぎむ}がある。
examples.english: There is a duty of confidentiality.

examples.japanese: {医師|いし}には{患者|かんじゃ}の{情報|じょうほう}に{関|かん}する{守秘義務|しゅひぎむ}がある。
examples.english: Doctors have a duty of confidentiality regarding patient information.

examples.japanese: {守秘義務|しゅひぎむ}に{違反|いはん}した{場合|ばあい}、{法的|ほうてき}な{責任|せきにん}を{問|と}われる{可能性|かのうせい}がある。
examples.english: If you violate the duty of confidentiality, you may face legal consequences.

notes:
USAGE:
{守秘義務|しゅひぎむ} is a formal legal and professional term. It commonly appears in employment contracts and professional codes of conduct.

WORD FORMATION:
{守秘|しゅひ} (keeping secrets) + {義務|ぎむ} (duty, obligation).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {守秘義務|しゅひぎむ}がある: to have a duty of confidentiality
- {守秘義務|しゅひぎむ}を{守|まも}る: to uphold confidentiality
- {守秘義務|しゅひぎむ}に{違反|いはん}する: to violate confidentiality
- {守秘義務|しゅひぎむ}{契約|けいやく}: confidentiality agreement (NDA)
